units.source_text: 我从学校回来，漫不经心地打开了书桌的抽屉，看见了一个白纸包。

en.t: When I came back from school, I casually opened the drawer of my desk and saw a package wrapped in white paper.

units.source_text: 里面就是包着那张照片，上面连一个字也没有。

en.t: Inside it was that photograph, wrapped up, and there was not a single word written on it.
